title: 第4933章 你们百帝山不肯放过我叶炎第4932章 百帝山有神尊子嗣
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：武道丹帝第一卷：默认第4933章你们百帝山不肯放过我叶炎？（..la）震颤！
惊措！
这一道声音，不仅是此片区域的修炼者，更是让十大界域、万族修炼者全都听得清清楚楚。
神尊子嗣，没有湮灭。
还在世间？
“这……怎么可能？”只是，一些老辈修炼者愕然。
神尊处在古老的荒古时代，距今极为遥远。
这等势力能够出现在世间，对于很多人而言，都算是奇迹，甚至有人觉得这些势力的底蕴不再强大，或许只是一个空壳子。
但如今，百帝山的这一位存在，竟是如此言语？
“这话当真？”
“百帝山内，真的还有神尊后人？”
“甚至，还有神尊子嗣？”
嘶！
即便是自己开口，但这话语落下，也使得所有人唏嘘一叹。
神尊子嗣啊！
那，该多强？
“传闻，天帝、神尊、仙帝，皆是在大帝之上，可怕至极，可也有人所言，神尊甚至比天帝还强。”
这？
这乃是传闻，谁也不清楚。
毕竟，神尊与天帝都没处在一个时代。

两者也不会一战，分出强弱。
可，这传闻，却是由来已久。
若百帝山这一位存在说的是真的，那……
百帝山如今的底蕴，得多强？
“曾经他们销声匿迹，近乎消失在了世间，如今在这个时代突然出现，而且还有神尊后人，甚至是神尊子嗣？甚至还说比叶炎强大，难道……难道他们在这个时代，也要……也要一争那大帝之位吗？”
咕咚！
当此声落下，所有人震颤到了极致。
神尊势力，也要争夺？
而且，神尊留下了子嗣，尘封到了今日？
难道，在荒古时代，那一位神尊，就算到了今日乃是大时代？
算到了这个时代，将出一位天帝？
“不该啊！”
“若如此，为何神尊不让自己的子嗣在上古时代出现？毕竟在那个时代，也出现了诸多天帝。”
“是啊，毕竟天帝之位，并非只有这个时代独有。”
此时，很多人惊诧。
“难道？”
“这个时代……”
“不仅仅是天帝那般简单？”
“大时代我清楚，那大纪元……究竟是什么，难道……”此时，很多人对视一眼，这时代，究竟牵扯到了什么？
如今在众人看来，百帝山的这存在不至于会说假话，那若真的如此，在这样的大纪元下，真的只是天帝那般简单吗？
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Martial Arts Alchemy Emperor Volume 1: Default Chapter 4933 Your Baidi Mountain is unwilling to let me go, Ye Yan? (..la) Tremor!
Shocked!
This voice can be heard clearly not only by the practitioners in this area, but also by all the practitioners from the ten major realms and all races.
There is no annihilation in the descendants of gods.
Still in this world?
"How... is this possible?" However, some older cultivators were stunned.
The deity lived in an ancient and barren era, extremely far away from now.
For many people, it is a miracle that such forces can appear in the world. Some people even think that these forces are no longer strong and may just be empty shells.
But now, this person from Baidi Mountain actually speaks like this?
"Is this true?"
"Are there really descendants of the deity in Baidi Mountain?"
"There are even descendants of the god?"
Hiss!
Even if he spoke it himself, the words would make everyone sigh.
O descendant of God!
So, how strong should it be?
"It is rumored that the Heavenly Emperor, the Divine Lord, and the Immortal Emperor are all above the Great Emperor and are extremely terrifying. However, some people say that the Divine Lord is even stronger than the Heavenly Emperor."
This?
This is just a rumor and no one knows for sure.
After all, the God Lord and the Heavenly Emperor are not in the same era.
The two will not fight to determine the strength and weakness.
However, this rumor has been around for a long time.
If what this being from Baidi Mountain said is true, then...
How strong is Baidi Mountain’s current foundation?
"They once disappeared and almost disappeared from the world, but now they suddenly appear in this era, and there are descendants of the god, and even the heirs of the god? They are even said to be stronger than Ye Yan. Could it be that... in this era, they also want to... also compete for the position of the great emperor?"
Gudong!
When this sound fell, everyone was trembling to the extreme.
Do you also want to fight for the power of the gods?
Moreover, the deity left behind an heir, and the dust remains to this day?
Could it be that in the ancient times, that god was a great person even today?
In this era, will there be an emperor?
"You shouldn't!"
"If that's the case, why didn't the god allow his descendants to appear in ancient times? After all, many emperors of heaven also appeared in that era."
"Yes, after all, the position of Emperor of Heaven is not unique to this era."
At this time, many people were surprised.
"Could it be?"
"This era..."
"It's not just as simple as the Emperor of Heaven?"
"I know the Great Era well. What exactly is the Great Era? Could it be..." At this time, many people looked at each other. What exactly is involved in this era?
Now in the eyes of everyone, the existence of Baidi Mountain is not capable of telling lies. If this is true, in such an era, is it really as simple as the Emperor of Heaven?
